name: Agent message
description: One session message as a full, normal Hypermedia Comment, augmented with agent metadata. A user message is signed by the user's account (or a delegated device key carrying a capability); an agent message is signed by one of the agent's signing identities. It targets the session document (space and path), threads via threadRoot and replyParent, and its body may contain agent-tool-call-block and agent-tool-result-block nodes linking content-addressed tool records. This replaces the server-private MessageSession log entry as the canonical record of what was said.

actor.description: Who authored this message in the session's shared workspace log.

agent.description: The agent document this message belongs to, for indexing messages across sessions.

runId.description: The run that produced an agent-authored message.

clientMessageId.description: Client-chosen id echoed back so a sender can replace its optimistic pending row by identity.
